constraints: INDEPENDENT SESSION. Read only the named snapshot commits.
REGENERATE, DO NOT ACCEPT. Rebuild both curve instances from master seed 2301, rebuild both frozen deterministic 512-element factor bases, and confirm factor_base_sha256 at each bit size.

Recompute INT-2 yourself on a sample of half-tuples FROM THE SPECIFICATION AND THE MANIFEST ALONE - c_2 = (x_i - x_j)**2, c_1 = -2 * ((x_i + x_j) * (x_i * x_j + a) + 2 * b), c_0 = (x_i * x_j - a)**2 - 4 * b * (x_i + x_j), e_1 = (-c_1) * c_2**(-1) mod p, e_2 = c_0 * c_2**(-1) mod p - and confirm the recorded pairs. If the frozen map is not reproducible from the manifest alone, that fires N-0.
Confirm each real arm is EXHAUSTIVE over the C(512, 2) = 130816 unordered half-tuples with i < j, with no duplicate, no omission and no diagonal entry.

CHECK CTRL-EQD-DRIVER-HASH YOURSELF - the driver sha256 in the real manifest must equal the DRIVER_SHA256 bound by the TASK-20260801-022 calibration snapshot receipt. A difference fires N-0 and invalidates the real run outright. This is ATS-1 clause 5 made checkable and it is your duty, not the reviewer's.

CONFIRM STRUCTURALLY, FROM THE ARCHIVED CALIBRATION PACKAGE ITSELF, that the calibration run enumerated NO half-tuple of the deterministic factor base, contains NO OBJ-REAL sample and NO deterministic factor-base x-list, and that the real-arm entry point was not invoked there. Do not take the contract's sentence for it.
TRACE EVERY THRESHOLD IN THE READING RULE to a named order statistic of a named CAL-1 output and RECOMPUTE IT from the archived replicate values. A threshold you cannot trace fires N-0.
Recompute every reported statistic - STAT-CHI-16, STAT-CHI-64, STAT-KS1-E1, STAT-KS1-E2 and STAT-DUP - from the raw record, including the empty-cell omission count and the degrees of freedom.
Confirm every recorded e_1 and e_2 lies in [0, p), that every arm has exactly 130816 pairs, and that the real-arm admissible-support fraction is exactly 1.0.
Confirm CTRL-EQD-S3 reports 1000 of 1000 at both cells and that its verification used a code path that does not reuse the coefficient formula.

Confirm the null pipeline differs from the real pipeline ONLY in the source of the 512 points, by direct source reading, and report any other difference as a defect. Confirm the real-arm null stream is 2301 + 50000 + bits and is disjoint from every calibration stream.

Report explicitly whether ANY N-0 or N-5 condition fired - a sample set with other than 130816 pairs, any c_2 = 0 draw, a real-arm support fraction other than 1.0, a driver hash mismatch, CTRL-EQD-S3 below 1000 of 1000, an untraceable threshold, an irreproducible INT-2, any timeout, crash, resource exhaustion or budget cancellation, PC-1 failing to reject, DV-7 rejecting, or in-run null-vs-null statistics outside the archived CAL-1 distribution beyond the declared margin.
Confirm the package contains NO factorization, NO smoothness statistic, NO search arm, NO timing decision variable, NO cost identity and NO R.
Confirm manifest.yaml is present with its required fields and that command.txt, environment.json, stdout.log, stderr.log and raw-result.json exist beside it.
Do NOT interpret H-EQD-001 or HEUR-DS-1, do NOT classify the result against RR-EQD-1, and do NOT state a disposition.
Treat no calibration number as evidence about any hypothesis; the calibration run is expressly non-evidential.
Timeouts and crashes are infrastructure, never mathematical negatives.
MAKE NO COMMIT. Do not alter any ledger record.

constraints: INDEPENDENT SESSION.

SYMMETRY IS MANDATORY. Premature closure is a failure mode symmetric with overclaiming (docs/inventor-protocol.md section 4). Attack a negative-looking result exactly as hard as a positive-looking one.

AUDIT THE ATTAINABILITY ARGUMENT AGAINST THE ACTUAL DATA and say plainly whether any band or branch turned out unreachable after all. This is the BATCH-021 defect RT048-B2 and the BATCH-022 finding RV012-A1, and you are the last line on both.

AUDIT ATS-1 POST HOC. With the real numbers visible, say whether the calibration supplied or selected, and whether the driver executed at the real arm is byte-identical to the one the calibration froze.

LIMB DISCIPLINE IS BLOCKING. L1 - that (e_1, e_2) is not uniform on F_p x F_p with support density about 1/8 - is a DERIVATION and may not be reported as a finding of this batch under any branch. L3 - the dependency-structure comparison - is an instrument fact and may not be reported as a result about the Semaev map. Say explicitly whether any deliverable violates either.

THE HEUR-DS-1 LINE IS BLOCKING. Equidistribution of the fibre invariants is a LOAD-BEARING INPUT to HEUR-DS-1 and is NOT identical to it. This experiment measures no smoothness, factors no integer and computes no largest prime factor. Say explicitly whether any deliverable blurs that, and confirm the smoothness measurement is still recorded as OWED under OPEN-BATCH023-A.

dominated_by may not be null; carry a quantitative sota_delta, and note that for a distributional measurement of this kind the relevant frontier row is the matched-null comparison itself rather than any algorithm.

Carry RT047-B5, RT048-B1, RT048-B2, RT048-B5, RT048-B9, RT048-H1, RT048-H2, RT048-M1, RV012-A1, RV012-A2, RV012-B1, RV012-B2, RV012-B3 and RV012-B6 forward and state each one's status - discharged, partially discharged or still open - after this run.

Say explicitly whether PC-1's power certificate covers the alternative class the decision statistics actually faced, or only the plant class, and what that leaves uncertified.
Toy stays toy; promotion gates G1-G4 remain OPEN unless you prove otherwise with archived artifacts.

State explicitly that your session is independent in the AGENTS.md sense but NOT in the model sense under this harness, and that it is not admissible toward the three-model closure quorum of AGENTS.md rule 13.
Do not alter H-EQD-001, H-SMTH-001, H-DS-001, H-IC-001 or H-STR-002. MAKE NO COMMIT.
handoff.objective: Challenge any reading of this measurement stronger than a toy-scoped distributional observation about limb L2, IN BOTH DIRECTIONS AND WITH EQUAL FORCE. If the real arm looks indistinguishable from the matched null, attack that - name every way the apparatus could manufacture agreement, starting with insufficient resolution and with power that exists only against the plant class, and say whether PC-1 genuinely establishes that the statistic could have rejected THE ALTERNATIVE THAT MATTERED rather than a different one. If it looks like a deviation, attack that at least as hard - name every non-structural channel that could produce it, including the binning unevenness when K does not divide p, the half-tuple dependency structure, the finite factor base, the redraw policy on the null side, and any bias in the real-arm null stream. THEN AUDIT THE ATTAINABILITY ARGUMENT AGAINST THE ACTUAL DATA - was the branch that fired one your own arithmetic confirms was reachable, and did any branch that did NOT fire turn out to be unreachable after all. AND AUDIT ATS-1 POST HOC - with the real numbers now visible, does the reading rule still look like a substitution of measured numbers into a pre-frozen form, or does any part of it look chosen. Finally, state plainly whether any deliverable of this batch blurs the line between equidistribution of the fibre invariants and HEUR-DS-1.
handoff.uncertainty_reduced: Whether this measurement genuinely bears on limb L2, or whether a third explanation - the instrument, the binning, the dependency structure, the plant class or the sampling design - survives.
